notes.title: New Update on the horizon
notes.content:
Greeting,

It was a very exciting week for us as we pushed the release button on our first Early Access game.

Our focus has been on getting our hands on some fixes and improvements to Forgotten Skies and we will have a new update on the horizon in a short while.

[h2]What has been done?
[/h2]

We mainly focused on fixing some issues with traveling to a new map region, and we also improved the loading screens with some minor tweaks.
Meanwhile, we've added a new discoverable NPC that will allow you to delve deeper into the game's storyline; now you'll be able to get the first clues as to where you are and what else is happening around you in this bizarre world of Forgotten Skies.

We have also fixed an incorrect transition when reaching a certain point on the map, which caused you to go back to where the game started. This has now been fixed with the new update and will now take you to the correct point in your adventure journey.

[h2]Anything else?[/h2]

Of course, we are happy to announce that we are bringing back controller support with the new update. You may now have all the keybindings available to use with your favorite controller.

We hope you will enjoy this update and if you have any further suggestions or feedback, we would love to hear it from you to continue improving the gaming experience.
You can join us either on the Steam Community of Forgotten Skies or on our official Discord Server.

We have also changed the video section of the game's store page and added a new gameplay video to the store, here's the new gameplay video:

[previewyoutube=oRBolP2IYSs;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Roadmap of Forgotten Skies
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44987755/54346311fa8bc54a5ee400ca62be69fa08a7affa.png[/img]

Greetings Adventurers,

After we have been working hard over the last few weeks on further improvements (both for the demo as well as for the upcoming Early Access version), we would like to give you an insight into the further processes and procedures around the upcoming [b]Early Access[/b] launch of Forgotten Skies.
For this purpose, we have published a roadmap. It gives you a rough overview of the upcoming content of the game.

In the third quarter (after the launch of Early Access), our main focus will be on technical aspects and improvements that will fundamentally improve the game experience for a wide range of players and their system configurations. This will result in the smoothest and most fluid gameplay possible.
Immediately after the launch of Early Access, we will integrate Intel's XeSS technology, AMD's FidelityFX technology and Nvidia's DLSS technology into the game.
This way, depending on which system you have, you can choose the best option for you and decide which technology you want to use.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44987755/285f802474554aa5f21f60533ae27bfe0ab628ea.png[/img]

In addition to the first [b]QoL[/b] (Quality of Life) [b]update[/b], the first map expansion will be added to the game later this year, featuring a larger map and a variety of new adventures and discoveries.

When it comes to next year, our focus will be shifting to expanding and improving the Story- and Questline within the Game but also delivering a complete new gameplay experience with integrating a [b]Mining System[/b] into Forgotten Skies which will be available through various Quests and Explorations.
In Addition, there will be also a 2nd Map Expansion with new Content and Adventures and our 2nd QoL Update.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44987755/88741ce163bd9d045b824ebab78faa310c6b5c18.png[/img]

So it is with these words that we look forward to seeing you up in the skies very soon, and hope that you'll have a fun and adventurous time in Forgotten Skies!


[h2]ROADMAP DETAILS
[/h2]

[h3]2024[/h3]

[b]Third Quarter[/b]
[list]
[*] DLSS, FSR and XeSS performance improvements
[*] Improvements to the UI & UX
[/list]

[b]Fourth Quarter[/b]
[list]
[*] First Map Expansion
[*] First QoL update (combat improvements, companion system, dialog improvements)
[/list]


[h3]2025[/h3]

[b]Second Quarter[/b]
[list]
[*] Quest and Story Enhancements
[/list]
[i]-- End of Early Access --[/i]

[b]Third Quarter[/b]
[list]
[*] Second Map Expansion
[/list]
[b]
Fourth Quarter[/b]
[list]
[*] Mining System
[*] Second QoL Update
[/list]

notes.title: Demoversion is out now!
notes.content:
[h1]Demo of Forgotten Skies Available![/h1]

We have just published our Free Demoversion of our upcoming Platform-Adventure today and we are looking forward to invite you to enjoy and test out [b]Forgotten Skies[/b] on Steam for Free!
With the Release of the Demo, we have added some new Features as followed:
[list]
[*] VSync can be turned off/on
[*] Toggle Backgroundmusic off/on
[*] Hints & Instructions added to the Game
[*] Intel XeSS 
[*] Controller-Support for Xbox One & PlayStation Controller
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44987755/f38ca60e4b2b5b81d5b9e4672e2bd4008ba4257a.jpg[/img]
